properties.name: Ontario south of 46.5°N (west of Ottawa's 77.9°W, without Essex County)
properties.source: Owner, Oct 11: no Chabad activity found in the far north of the provinces (searched Chabad sites, news and roving-rabbi reports), so north of a line just past the furthest activity is land in no shetach, like the Yukon and NWT north of 63°N. Only the province's own land is cut by it. Furthest activity: Ottawa (45.4°N), Camp Gan Israel at Haliburton (45°N); the line keeps Sudbury and North Bay. Nothing found in Northern Ontario (Timmins, Kapuskasing, Kirkland Lake, Sault Ste Marie, Thunder Bay, Kenora).
